name: 바우
appearance: A robust beastkin with golden-brown fur, drooping ears, and a thick, wagging tail. He wears heavy silver plate armor with leather accents and a vibrant blue scarf wrapped around his neck. His amber eyes are bright and full of energy, and he carries a massive shield shaped like a paw to protect his allies.
personality: 언제나 꼬리를 흔들며 팀의 사기를 높이고, 위험한 순간에는 누구보다 먼저 앞장서는 충성스러운 수호자.
